summary.focus: Post-GA growth readiness and acquisition instrumentation without GTM redesign
summary.highest_priority_action: Create a GA baseline pack over a 7-14 day pre/post GA window

findings.statement: Acquisition baseline is missing, preventing reliable post-GA delta measurement.
GitHub Pages is intent-confirmed but not yet operationalized as a measured funnel input.
Community-led growth is still under consideration, reducing planning confidence.
In-product telemetry infrastructure exists and is usable for baseline capture.
Activation/retention KPI definitions are not codified as an operational measurement contract.

risks.description: Missing baseline data can drive incorrect post-GA prioritization.
mitigations: Build GA baseline pack before launch

risks.description: Undecided community strategy can cause forecast variance and execution drift.
mitigations: Assign channel owner and review date

risks.description: Uncodified KPI contract can cause inconsistent reporting.
mitigations: Freeze minimal event contract for first 30 days

recommendations.action: Create GA baseline pack before external launch.
Define and freeze a minimal acquisition/activation event contract for the first 30 days post-GA.
Operationalize GitHub Pages as a tracked top-of-funnel channel with weekly referral checks.
Resolve community growth direction to YES_NOW or DEFER_AFTER_GA_PLUS_30.
Publish a one-page Growth Operations Runbook for post-GA execution.
